verdict.rationale: Termius states it secures connections with device-bound keys and biometric protection via Windows Hello, Touch ID/Face ID, or Android biometrics. It also supports FIDO2 hardware security keys, which together cover the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that device-bound keys live in a hardware secure enclave/TPM and are non-exportable, in-depth docs pages beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
